items.question: What does the Founder payment secure?
items.answer: It secures one of the first 100 numbered ASSAULT production allocations and the associated Founder ownership package.

items.question: When will production begin?
items.answer: Production begins only after final component, load, recovery and real-world validation is complete and the first-run specification is locked.

items.question: What happens if production does not proceed?
items.answer: The complete Founder payment and refund conditions will be defined before allocation opens and will not be hidden in general website terms.

items.question: How will progress be communicated?
items.answer: Founder members receive direct validation, manufacturing and delivery updates before wider public release.

items.question: What is included?
items.answer: A numbered Founder rod, selected cap and offshore pack colourway, Founder certificate and registered digital rod passport.

items.question: What warranty and delivery terms apply?
items.answer: Final warranty coverage, delivery costs and transfer conditions will be published clearly before payment is accepted.
